data.title: Health and care insurance contribution notice from 1 October 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK informs you that your monthly health and long-term care insurance contribution rises from €146.29 to €156.55 from 1 October 2026. The basis is the new BAföG need of €915.00 per month.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has recalculated your student contribution because the BAföG-based income figure rose. From 1 October 2026 you pay €156.55 a month instead of €146.29. It will be debited automatically on the 15th of each month, first at the new amount on 15 October 2026. You may object (Widerspruch) if you disagree; the app shows the deadline. An objection does not suspend payment, so the new amount is due meanwhile. Make sure your account has enough money for the debit.

items.title: Objection against contribution notice (optional)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at Muster BKK if you disagree with the notice.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final. An objection does not suspend payment.

items.title: Monthly health and care insurance contribution
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag wie bisher zum 15. eines Monats ab, den neuen Betrag erstmals am 15.10.2026.
items.action: Keep enough funds in your account for the direct debit on the 15th of each month.
